fusions.name: Headsman's Tether
fusions.desc: Drops a chained blade on an enemy at or below 25% health for 22 damage, using up every affliction on it to add 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Whirling Bit
fusions.desc: Whirls an axe-head on a chain around you, which deals 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Bleeding] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Pendulum Blade
fusions.desc: Hangs an axe-head on a chain where you stand for 12 seconds. It swings at an enemy within 3 tiles for 6 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Carry Through
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your chain whips on to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
